changelog:
- Initial release of the "open-ended-curriculum" skill: agent autonomously generates endlessly increasing, non-repetitive challenges to continually push ability boundaries.
- Provides a real executable curriculum generation script (`scripts/curriculum.py`) supporting difficulty escalation and novelty enforcement.
- Introduces four-dimensional scoring (value, novelty, feasibility, alignment) to evaluate challenges and ensure measurable progress.
- Ensures curriculum never saturates: strictly increasing difficulty, enforced novelty, and healthy score progression are all verified by self-test.
- Includes a self-evolving learning framework (`scripts/learner.py`) that records feedback, tracks error patterns and user preferences, and regularly improves curriculum quality and efficiency.
summary: 开放世界无限课程：让智能体自己造越来越难、且彼此不重复的挑战，把能力边界无限推开——课程永不饱和。 这是决定"能否持续超越"的元能力：一线大模型等人工喂题、题做完了就停，本技能让 agent 自主生成递增强度课程。 当用户要求永不饱和的课程、自主造题、能力边界无限推开、开放世界自训练时使用。
